title: The 15-Minute Weekend Home Check That Prevents Small Problems From Hiding
description: A short weekly scan for leaks, loose hardware, blocked vents and other issues that are easier to fix early.
body_html:
You do not need a giant maintenance checklist every weekend. A short repeatable scan is more likely to happen, and it can catch obvious problems before they become expensive surprises.

Minute 1–3: water

Look under sinks, around toilets and near visible appliance connections for dampness, stains or unusual smells. You are looking for change, not perfection.

Minute 4–6: movement

Test a few doors, cabinet handles and commonly used furniture pieces. Tighten a loose handle or note a larger repair before it becomes a failure.

Minute 7–9: air

Check that bathroom and kitchen ventilation is not visibly blocked. Notice rooms that feel unusually damp or stale and investigate the cause rather than masking it.

Minute 10–12: safety

Keep walkways clear and check that extension leads, chargers and visible electrical accessories are not damaged. Never improvise repairs on damaged electrical equipment.

Minute 13–15: the one annoying thing

Pick one small problem you have been ignoring: a sticking drawer, loose hook, missing seal or cable that keeps falling behind a desk. Fix it or write down the next concrete step.

The rule

Do not turn this into a project. The goal is to notice small changes early and keep a short list of real work that deserves a proper repair session.
